dialogue.origin: （こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for coming today.)

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm a counselor here. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 40歳、女性、子供が学校に行かれなくて悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm 40, female, and I'm worried because my child can't go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは心配ですよね・・。お子さんの学年と性別を教えてくださいますか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very worrying for you. Could you tell me your child's grade and gender?

dialogue.origin: 1年生で、男の子です
dialogue.content: He's a first grader and a boy.

dialogue.origin: 小学生です
dialogue.content: He's in elementary school.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。学校へ行かれなくなったきっかけはどのようなことがありましたか？
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you. Was there anything specific that triggered him to stop going to school?

dialogue.origin: 元々、あまり行かれてなかったのですが、ゴールデンウィーク明けに、怖い夢を見て、眠れず
dialogue.content: He hadn't been going to school very regularly to begin with, but after Golden Week, he had a scary dream and couldn't sleep.

dialogue.origin: 朝起きれなくて、行かれなくなりました
dialogue.content: He couldn't wake up in the morning, so he stopped going.

dialogue.origin: それが1番大きな理由ですかね。
dialogue.content: I think that's the biggest reason.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったのですね。怖い夢を見られたのが一番大きな理由なのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you feel that the scary dream is the main reason.

dialogue.origin: 朝起きられれば、楽しいようで、お昼から行ったり出来るのですが
dialogue.content: If he can wake up in the morning, he seems to enjoy school, and sometimes he's able to go in the afternoon.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。夢が原因かと
dialogue.content: Yes, I think the dreams are the cause.

dialogue.origin: 怖い夢を見て、朝起きられないのが原因かな？と思われているんですね・・。
dialogue.content: So you're thinking that maybe the cause is him having scary dreams and then not being able to wake up in the morning.

dialogue.origin: 時々はお昼から行けるということですね・・。
dialogue.content: And you mentioned that sometimes he is able to go in the afternoon.

dialogue.origin: そうです。それから、常に私が一緒にいないとダメで、それも凄く疲れてます
dialogue.content: That's right. Also, he needs me to be with him all the time, and that's extremely exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 私が辛くて、学校に行かせられない感じです。
dialogue.content: It's so hard on me that I feel like I can't make him go to school.

dialogue.origin: 付き添い登校なので
dialogue.content: Because I have to accompany him to school.

dialogue.origin: もう最近は、私が疲弊してて、グッタリしてます
dialogue.content: Lately, I've been completely depleted and worn out.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。付き添いの登校をされているのですね。毎日のことだと、それはお母様もとても疲れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you've been accompanying him to school. When it's every day, that must be incredibly tiring for you.

dialogue.origin: 多分もっと私が元気だったら、多い日数で、付き添い登校できると思うのですが、
dialogue.content: If I had more energy, I think I could accompany him on more days, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今は夏休みで、気持ちが随分と楽です
dialogue.content: Now it's summer vacation, so I feel much more relaxed.

dialogue.origin: 一学期も殆どいかれてなくて…
dialogue.content: He barely went at all during the first semester either...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 子供が夜寝るのが遅いので私はもっと遅くて、疲れてます
dialogue.content: My son goes to bed late, so I go to bed even later, and I'm exhausted.

dialogue.origin: もうヘトヘトです
dialogue.content: I'm completely drained.

dialogue.origin: 夏休みが明ける事を考えると嫌になります、
dialogue.content: I dread thinking about summer vacation ending.

dialogue.origin: 毎度毎度、学校へ欠席の連絡をしなあといけないのも苦痛で
dialogue.content: It's also painful to have to contact the school every single time to report his absence.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね・・。
dialogue.content: Yes, I can imagine that would be...

dialogue.origin: それについては、先生と話しましたが、「安否確認のため」と
dialogue.content: I talked to the teacher about it, and they said it was "to confirm his safety."

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: スマホでいいとは、言ってくれたので、それは少し気が楽になりましたが
dialogue.content: They did say I could just send a message from my phone, so that made it a little easier.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです。電話だと気持ち的にも負担がありますよね。
dialogue.content: That's good. A phone call can be more of an emotional burden, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 私としては早く1人で学校に行ってほしくて
dialogue.content: For my part, I just want him to be able to go to school by himself soon.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.origin: とにかくずーと一緒なので、だんだん鬱陶しくて
dialogue.content: We're together all the time, and it's gradually becoming suffocating.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ずっと一緒だとそういった気持ちになるのも自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's natural to feel that way when you're together constantly.

dialogue.origin: 子供がねてからじゃないと、ゆっくり出来なくて、その時にはもう夜は明けかけてるんですよね
dialogue.content: I can't relax until after my son falls asleep, and by then, it's almost dawn.

dialogue.origin: そうあったんですね・・。それは睡眠も取れずに、朝が来てしまい辛いと思います。
dialogue.content: I see that's how it's been. It must be so difficult for you, not getting any sleep before the morning comes.

dialogue.origin: それが、ずーっと５月から続いているので、限界です
dialogue.content: This has been going on since May, and I'm at my limit.

dialogue.origin: どうしたら、夜怖い夢を見ずに寝られるのか？
dialogue.content: What can I do so he can sleep at night without having scary dreams?

dialogue.origin: 早くに寝ても、途中で夢で起きてしまうことがあるので
dialogue.content: Even if he goes to bed early, he sometimes wakes up in the middle of the night from a dream.

dialogue.origin: 小児科の先生とは、相談してるのですが
dialogue.content: I've been consulting with his pediatrician, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 先生はどのような対応がいいと言っていましたか？
dialogue.content: What did the doctor suggest as a good approach?

dialogue.origin: 中々改善方法が見つからず眠剤も飲めないので、昨年９月かしら？薬飲めないなら、半年後再診、
dialogue.content: We haven't been able to find a good solution, and he can't take sleeping pills. I think it was last September? They said if he can't take medication, to come back for a follow-up in six months.

dialogue.origin: となってしまって
dialogue.content: And that was it.

dialogue.origin: お忙しい先生で、月に1回しか来られない先生なんです
dialogue.content: He's a very busy doctor who only comes to the clinic once a month.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったんですね。今のところ夢に対しての対処方法は薬が飲めないとできないということですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. For now, it seems the only way to deal with the dreams is with medication, which he can't take.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 夢に関してはどうにもならないのではないかと…
dialogue.content: I'm starting to think there's nothing that can be done about the dreams...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable...

dialogue.origin: 色々と調べるとPTSDとか、悪夢を見やすいと書かれていて
dialogue.content: I've been doing some research, and I read that things like PTSD can make you prone to nightmares.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夜驚症って、酷く夜泣きのようですが
dialogue.content: And night terrors are like severe night crying, right?

dialogue.origin: そういうのもあるんですよね
dialogue.content: There are things like that too, right?

dialogue.origin: ええ、よくお調べになっているのですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, you've done a lot of research.

dialogue.origin: だから、普通20時くらいに寝て、朝まで寝てるお子さんが多いと思いますが、
dialogue.content: So, I think most children go to bed around 8 p.m. and sleep until morning, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ウチはそんな時間に寝ると、中途覚醒しちゃうんです
dialogue.content: If my son goes to bed at that time, he wakes up in the middle of the night.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 不登校になった原因の日も、20時30分頃寝たんです
dialogue.content: On the day that triggered his school refusal, he went to bed around 8:30 p.m.

dialogue.origin: 珍しく
dialogue.content: which was unusual for him,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そして、22時頃夢で起きて
dialogue.content: And then he woke up from a dream around 10 p.m.

dialogue.origin: それから4時30分まで、起きてました
dialogue.content: After that, he was awake until 4:30 a.m.

dialogue.origin: 怖くて寝られないといって
dialogue.content: saying he was too scared to sleep.

dialogue.origin: 今度病院の先生を変えてもらおうと思っているんですけど
dialogue.content: I'm thinking of asking to change his doctor next time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 支援センターの、ママ友に聞いたら、飲みやすいお薬わもらって、そのお子さんが落ち着いて来ているとのお話しを聞いたので
dialogue.content: A mom friend from the support center told me they received an easy-to-take medicine, and her child has been settling down, so...

dialogue.origin: ウチ、神経発達症なんですよね
dialogue.content: You see, my son has a neurodevelopmental disorder.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったんですね・・。色々な方に相談や情報をもらっているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you're consulting with and getting information from many different people.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。沢山本も読んでますし
dialogue.content: Yes. I've also been reading a lot of books.

dialogue.origin: 自分の子供のことですから
dialogue.content: It's about my own child, after all.

dialogue.origin: でも、支援センターに行くようになって、随分と良くなって来ているんです
dialogue.content: But since we started going to the support center, things have been getting much better.

dialogue.origin: 一昨年くらいでしたか、別のママ友に偶然色々とお話しを伺って、そこに辿り着きました
dialogue.content: I think it was the year before last; I happened to hear about it from another mom friend and found my way there.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。大切なお子さんのために様々な対応をされていて、とてもいいお母様だと感じます。色々努力されていたので、そういった方に巡りあうことができたのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. You're doing so much for your precious child; I feel you're a very good mother. Because you've been trying so hard, you were able to meet people like that.

dialogue.origin: でもその後からですかね、だんだん特性が顕著にみららるようになってかたのはか
dialogue.content: But I think it was after that, his specific traits started to become more prominent.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 最近は、みんなの中に入る事が相当難しく
dialogue.content: Lately, it's become extremely difficult for him to join in with groups.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今はやめたんですが、スポーツクラブに入ってて、入ったばかりは、皆と一緒に出来たのですが
dialogue.content: He's quit now, but he was in a sports club, and when he first joined, he was able to participate with everyone else.

dialogue.origin: ええ、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 今はその輪の中も入れなくなり
dialogue.content: But now he can't even join in with the group.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうあったんですね。。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: でも、クラブは行きたくて、自らいくんですよ
dialogue.content: But he wants to go to the club and goes of his own accord.

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも中には、入れないんです。
dialogue.content: But he can't go inside and join in.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それをみてお母様はどう感じていますか？
dialogue.content: I see. How do you feel when you see that?

dialogue.origin: だから、私とホールの外で、やってまさ
dialogue.content: So, he does the activities with me outside the hall.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね・・
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation...

dialogue.origin: そりゃあ、前みたいに中に入って、一緒にやって欲しいですよ
dialogue.content: Of course, I want him to go inside and participate with everyone like he used to.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 側転だって「みんなの前で見本になって、やったんだ！」と嬉しそうでしたから
dialogue.content: He was so happy, saying, "I even did a cartwheel as an example in front of everyone!"

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それはすごいですね。お子様の成長に合わせて、本を読んだり調べたり、色々な方と交流されたり、よくお子さんを見れていると感じます。
dialogue.content: I see. That's amazing. To keep up with your child's development, you're reading books, doing research, and interacting with various people. I feel that you are observing your child very well.

dialogue.origin: 今はもっぱらYouTubeとゲームになってしまっていて、
dialogue.content: Now, it's mostly just YouTube and games.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そういった状況なんですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation.

dialogue.origin: もっと、同年代の子供たちと遊んで欲しいですからね
dialogue.content: I want him to play more with kids his own age.

dialogue.origin: でも、私と片時も離れられなくて、しんどいです😭
dialogue.content: But he can't be apart from me for even a moment, and it's so hard. 😭

dialogue.origin: 私も1人の時間や、仕事に行く余裕が欲しいですから
dialogue.content: I also want some time to myself and the leeway to go to work.

dialogue.origin: それは本当にしんどいと思います。ひとりの時間は欲しいですよね。現在お仕事はされていますか？
dialogue.content: That must be incredibly hard. It's natural to want time for yourself. Are you currently working?

dialogue.origin: 夜寝られて、朝学校へ行って、全部出席しやくてま良いから、離れる時間が欲しいでさ
dialogue.content: I just want some time apart. I wish he could sleep at night and go to school in the morning, even if he doesn't have perfect attendance.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだと思います。離れる時間ほしいですよね・・。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. You want some time apart...

dialogue.origin: 今は子供がこのような状態なので、仕事に行かれなくて、とても怖いこまっているんです
dialogue.content: With my child in this state, I can't go to work, and I'm very scared and troubled.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お困りですよね。今一緒に住んでいるご家族はどなたがいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I can see you're in a difficult situation. Who are you currently living with?

dialogue.origin: なので、貯蓄切りくずし生活で、それも心配です
dialogue.content: So we're living off our savings, and that's another worry.

dialogue.origin: 私と子供の2人だけです
dialogue.content: It's just me and my child.

dialogue.origin: 私の両親は近くに住んでいますが、色々あって、同居は無理なんで
dialogue.content: My parents live nearby, but for various reasons, living together isn't possible.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お二人で暮らしているのですね。ご両親とは同居は無理なんですね。預けたりとかはどうですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so it's just the two of you, and living with your parents isn't an option. What about asking them to look after him sometimes?

dialogue.origin: 他のシングルの友達は、ご両親た同居さらてるので、仕事に行かれてます
dialogue.content: My other single-parent friends live with their parents, so they're able to work.

dialogue.origin: 私と離れられないので、預けられません
dialogue.content: He can't be apart from me, so I can't leave him with them.

dialogue.origin: 以前は預けられていたのですが
dialogue.content: I used to be able to, though.

dialogue.origin: ええ、。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: 引越しの時に、行き違いがあって、新居に子供1人になった時に怖い思いをさせてしまったことがあって
dialogue.content: During our move, there was a miscommunication, and he ended up alone in the new house and had a frightening experience.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・そのようなことがあったのですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: 引越し先の家は、すぐ近くで
dialogue.content: The new house was very close by,

dialogue.origin: ええ・・。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 車でも、1分くらいのかところでしたが、
dialogue.content: only about a minute away by car, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 過集中で、聞こえてなかったようで
dialogue.content: But he was hyper-focused on something and apparently didn't hear me.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: うんが悪く、その時携帯も持ってなかったので、凄く不安になってしまったんですよね
dialogue.content: To make matters worse, he didn't have his phone with him at the time, so he became extremely anxious.

dialogue.origin: 私と、連絡が取れなくて
dialogue.content: He couldn't get in touch with me.

dialogue.origin: その一件があってから、なんですけど
dialogue.content: It's been like this ever since that incident.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: こんな話すると、非難されるので、家に1人にさせたなんて、言えないんですが
dialogue.content: I get criticized when I talk about this, so I can't really tell people that I left him home alone.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことがあったのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: そのような状況だったのですね。
dialogue.content: That was the situation you were in.

dialogue.origin: 以前知り合いに「いくら携帯を持っていても、未就学児を1人にさせるのは、芳しくない」言われてしまって
dialogue.content: An acquaintance once told me, "Even if he has a phone, it's not a good idea to leave a preschooler alone."

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。そう言われて、あなたはどう思われたのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. How did you feel when you were told that?

dialogue.origin: でも、小児科の先生は、携帯を持っ前から、5時間くらい留守番出来ます、と話しても何も言わなかったんですよ
dialogue.content: But even before he had a phone, I told the pediatrician that he could stay home alone for about five hours, and the doctor didn't say anything about it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね・・。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 私は凄く心配なので、それから、携帯を持たせたんです
dialogue.content: I was very worried, so after that, I got him a cell phone.

dialogue.origin: 芳しくないことぐらい、私が1番よく分かってますから😡
dialogue.content: I know better than anyone that it's not ideal! 😡

dialogue.origin: ええ、あなたはとてもお子さん思いだし、ここまでのお話を聞いて、あなたが悪いとは感じないです。
dialogue.content: Yes, you are very thoughtful of your child, and from what I've heard so far, I don't feel that you are at fault.

dialogue.origin: 以前は、自ら「家で待ってるー」と言って、5時間も1人になる事が出て来たので
dialogue.content: Before, he started saying on his own, "I'll wait at home," and would be by himself for as long as five hours.

dialogue.origin: 携帯を買って持たせたんです
dialogue.content: So I bought him a phone and had him carry it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、よく対応されていると思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think you handled that very well.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます😭
dialogue.content: Thank you... 😭

dialogue.origin: 色々な人に非難されたりするので、キツイです
dialogue.content: It's tough because I get criticized by so many people.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・非難されると自分が悪いのかな？と思ってしまいますよね。でも、あなたは十分頑張っていますし、その都度対応できています。仕方がないこともあります
dialogue.content: I understand... When you're criticized, it's easy to start thinking, "Am I the one who's wrong?" But you are trying more than enough, and you're responding to each situation as it comes. Some things just can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: 同じ神経発達症をもつママ友とも、よく話しますが、「非難される事ありすぎて、キツイよね」と話してます
dialogue.content: I often talk with mom friends whose children also have neurodevelopmental disorders, and we say, "It's so tough being criticized for everything, isn't it?"

dialogue.origin: あなたは頑張りすぎくらいです。お子さんを思う気持ちが伝わってきます
dialogue.content: You are trying almost too hard. I can really feel how much you care for your son.

dialogue.origin: そういったママ友がいてよかったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad you have mom friends like that.

dialogue.origin: 他者から理解して貰えず、母親が1番辛い思いをしていると、本にも書いてありました。
dialogue.content: I read in a book that when others don't understand, it's the mother who suffers the most.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ええ、あなたはよく本を読んで勉強されています。
dialogue.content: Yes, you read a lot of books and are very well-informed.

dialogue.origin: 周りの非難など気にせず、自信をもってほしいくらいです。
dialogue.content: I want you to be confident and not worry about criticism from others.

dialogue.origin: ここまでできる親御さんもそうたくさんいないのではないでしょうか・・？
dialogue.content: I don't think there are many parents who could do as much as you have.

dialogue.origin: 気にしない、とおもうんてますがあ、やっぱり気にするんですよね
dialogue.content: I tell myself not to care, but I end up caring anyway.

dialogue.origin: 気にはなりますよね・・。それはそうですよね・・
dialogue.content: It's natural that it would bother you... Of course it would.

dialogue.origin: 度々、「人は人、自分は自分」と、私の母は話していて
dialogue.content: My mother often tells me, "Let others be others; you are you."

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。でも、あなたのようなお母さんがいて、息子さんはこころ強いと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. But I think your son must feel very secure having a mother like you.

dialogue.origin: 頭でわかるのと、感情は違いますよね
dialogue.content: Understanding it logically and feeling it emotionally are two different things, aren't they?

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・。おっしゃる通りだと思います
dialogue.content: That's right... I think you're absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: 将来そう思ってくれたら、嬉しいなと思いながら、日々頑張ってます
dialogue.content: I'm doing my best every day, hoping that he'll think that way in the future.

dialogue.origin: おこがましいことでさが
dialogue.content: It may be presumptuous of me, but...

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話を聞いていて、あなたなら、そうできると思います。。
dialogue.content: From what I've heard today, I believe you can do it.

dialogue.origin: そうありたいです
dialogue.content: I want to be that way.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。お時間になってしまいましたが、ここまでお話をされてどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. It looks like our time is up, but how do you feel after talking about all of this?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、お話しが出来て良かったです。誰かに話すって大事ですね。
dialogue.content: Well, I'm glad I was able to talk. It's so important to talk to someone.

dialogue.origin: 今は友達ともご飯を食べに行く事が出来なくなってしまったのでさ
dialogue.content: I can't even go out to eat with my friends anymore.

dialogue.origin: 話す人がいないんですよね
dialogue.content: I don't really have anyone to talk to.

dialogue.origin: 皆それぞれ忙しくて…
dialogue.content: Everyone is busy with their own lives...

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。。ここには学校へ行かないと相談にきてくれましたが、話すことの大事さを気付かれたのですね。話す人がいないなら、またこちらにいらしていただければお話ができますので、いつでもお待ちしています・・。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. You came here to talk about your son not going to school, but you've realized the importance of talking itself. If you don't have anyone to talk to, you can always come back here, so please know we're always here for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: また、お願いします
dialogue.content: I'd like to do this again.

dialogue.origin: あなたのお話をいつでも聞けるようにどの相談員でも対応できます。
dialogue.content: Any of our counselors are available to listen to you anytime.

dialogue.origin: 今日はたくさんお話をありがとうございました。またぜひお話を聞かせてください。これで終了致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for sharing so much with me today. Please come and talk again. This concludes our session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （本日はお付き合いいただきありがとうございました。また機会がありましたらよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today. I look forward to assisting you again should the opportunity arise.)

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

topic.sub: お子さんの不登校問題
